basic_info.description: Ideally located where Cow Hollow, Russian Hill, and Pacific Heights intersect, this charming junior one-bedroom offers an efficient layout, great natural light, and timeless appeal for modern city living.  The well-scaled living room provides a warm and inviting atmosphere for relaxing or entertaining. A large kitchen with plentiful cabinet and counter space flows into a separate dining area, ideal for both daily living and hosting. The cleverly partitioned sleeping area offers privacy while maintaining an open, airy feel. Ample closet space, plus an extra storage area in the hall just outside the front door, adds convenience. With a near perfect 99 Walk Score, you're just minutes from Polk, Union, Fillmore, and Chestnut Streets, offering top restaurants, shops, cafes, fitness studios, and nightlife. Enjoy nearby access to Ft Mason, Aquatic Park, and the SF Bay waterfront. A commuter's dream, within one block of 3 Muni lines, tech shuttles and Golden Gate Transit connecting you easily to downtown, Marin, and beyond. Whether you're a 1st-time buyer, investor, or looking for a low-maintenance pied-a-terre, this thoughtfully designed home offers unbeatable value for a modern urban lifestyle in one of the city's most vibrant enclaves
